content.text:
# Markdown Processing Abstraction in `memos`

Markdown processing is abstracted behind a Go interface called `Service` (built on top of the `goldmark` library). Here are the findings, all verified against the source.

## 1. The interface

**`markdown.Service`** — `/bench/home/work/internal/markdown/markdown.go:31`

A rich interface (not just Parse/Render) with these methods: `ExtractAll`, `ExtractTags`, `ExtractProperties`, `RenderMarkdown`, `RenderHTML`, `GenerateSnippet`, `ValidateContent`, `RenameTag`. It handles markdown metadata extraction and server-side rendering (frontend uses markdown-it; backend uses this for RSS feeds, snippets, etc.).

## 2. Concrete implementation(s)

**`service`** struct (unexported) — `/bench/home/work/internal/markdown/markdown.go:58`
```go
type service struct {
	md goldmark.Markdown
}
```
This is the sole implementer of `Service`. All interface methods are defined on `*service` (lines 143–453). It wraps a `goldmark.Markdown` parser configured with GFM plus optional custom tag/mention extensions.

There is also a related but separate helper type used internally by `service` (not an implementer of `Service`):
- **`MarkdownRenderer`** struct — `/bench/home/work/internal/markdown/renderer/markdown_renderer.go:15`, constructed via `NewMarkdownRenderer()` at line 20. Used inside `service.RenderMarkdown` and `service.RenameTag` to render the AST back to markdown text.

## 3. Where the implementation is constructed

The constructor is **`markdown.NewService(opts ...Option) Service`** — `/bench/home/work/internal/markdown/markdown.go:85` (returns `&service{md: md}` at line 110).

Call sites (`NewService(...)`):
- `/bench/home/work/server/router/api/v1/v1.go:48` — inside `NewAPIV1Service`, with `WithTagExtension()` + `WithMentionExtension()`. This is the primary production instantiation.
- `/bench/home/work/server/router/api/v1/test/test_helper.go:44` — test setup.

Note: the same single instance is shared, not re-constructed, for RSS and the memopayload runner — `/bench/home/work/server/server.go:85` passes `apiV1Service.MarkdownService` into `rss.NewRSSService(...)`.

## 4. Structs that hold a `markdown.Service` field (dependency)

- **`APIV1Service`** — field `MarkdownService markdown.Service` at `/bench/home/work/server/router/api/v1/v1.go:35` (struct at line 22). Consumed in `memo_mention_helpers.go:32`, `memo_service.go:108` & `:447`, `memo_service_webhooks.go:85`.
- **`Runner`** (memopayload) — field `MarkdownService markdown.Service` at `/bench/home/work/server/runner/memopayload/runner.go:16` (struct at line 14; also passed as a param to the package-level `RebuildMemoPayload` at line 74).
- **`RSSService`** — field `MarkdownService markdown.Service` at `/bench/home/work/server/router/rss/rss.go:45`. Consumed in `rss.go:339` (`RenderHTML`).

Additionally, the test helper's service struct holds it at `/bench/home/work/server/router/api/v1/test/test_helper.go:52`.

### Summary of the wiring
`NewAPIV1Service` (v1.go:48) creates the one `service` instance → stored in `APIV1Service.MarkdownService` → shared into `RSSService` (server.go:85) and used by the memopayload `Runner` via `RebuildMemoPayload` (memo_service.go:108, :447). The interface lets all three consumers depend on the abstraction rather than the concrete goldmark-backed `service`.
